name: @niivue/nv-ext-wsi
description: Whole-slide images for NiiVue's NVSlide: pyramidal/tiled (OME-)TIFF and SVS by HTTP Range (geotiff), and local DICOM-WSI folders
comment:niivue-peer: A literal range, not workspace:* (which bun publish pins to the exact current rc), so one release accepts later niivue rcs and 1.x. devDependencies keeps workspace:* for local dev. The floor is the first niivue release with sparse slide levels and per-tile fileUrl (#581), which the DICOM-WSI index and its sparse slides need; raise it when this package needs a newer niivue API.
